item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

style.prompt: Premium studio product photograph of a scented candle in a frosted ivory glass jar with a small elegant cream label reading 'SANDALWOOD' and 'SCENTED CANDLE', a softly burning single wick, on a warm beige stone pedestal. Matching wooden lid resting beside the jar, subtle sandalwood pieces and a linen cloth nearby. Warm natural side lighting, soft realistic shadows, neutral cream background, sophisticated minimalist ecommerce styling, photorealistic wax and glass textures, sharp product focus, generous negative space, no extra text or watermark.
